text: 0143's length-8 cell never finished: its texts ran last and the clock ran out. Here it runs alone, sized to finish.
Four planted English texts enciphered with two random alphabets and an 8-letter key, each against four copies that keep the carved letters at the 24 known places.
4 of 4 beat all their copies (bar 3): the search can judge length 8. K4 at 8 is next.
